articles.title: Zcash developers plan a fix to keep ZEC swaps private from future quantum computers
articles.snippet: The team behind Zakura wants every swap through NEAR Intents to get its own key, so a refund address left on NEAR’s public chain can’t expose a user’s wider payment history.

articles.title: Bitwise, Hyperliquid seek SEC rule changes for token trading, airdrops
articles.snippet: The firms are seeking clearer guidance on the classification of crypto assets and secondary-market trading as the SEC’s public comment period comes to a close.

articles.title: FINMA approves Switzerland’s first Bitcoin ETF for retail investors
articles.snippet: The Swiss regulator cited a growing appetite for cryptocurrency investments and said that multiple fund providers have submitted Bitcoin ETF applications.

articles.title: Market participants weigh in on SEC’s proposed crypto regulations
articles.snippet: The financial agency is scheduled to close public comments on its ‘Regulation Crypto Assets’ proposed in August.

articles.title: Microsoft, Alphabet, Goldman Sachs Join Growing List of Companies Objecting to Tokenized Stocks
articles.snippet: Sixteen companies have now objected to having their shares traded on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, up from nine just four days earlier, according to an updated public notice.
